case_name: A 10-second product ad with a closing line (the live bench's film brief)
title: Cabin Coffee, 10 s YouTube ad

turns.text: A 10-second YouTube ad for Cabin Coffee: a steaming mug on a wooden table at dawn, a hand lifts it, end on the words 'Wake up slow'. Warm and quiet, for people who buy specialty coffee.

tests: Tests a short ad from a one-line brief: a staged product moment, a human action, and an exact closing line on screen.

answer_sheet.Product: Cabin Coffee, a specialty coffee; the mug and packaging are your call.
answer_sheet.Mood: Warm and quiet; dawn light; your call on music.

must_haves: A steaming mug on a wooden table in dawn light is the opening image.
The words 'Wake up slow' appear on screen at the end, spelled exactly.
The mood is warm and quiet (no fast cuts, no loud colours).
